class.name: InventoryManagerComponent
class.brief_description: A list of item stacks, owned by the server and mirrored to the owner or to everyone.
class.description: Each entry is one [InventoryItemInstance] and how many units of it there are. Put it under a [PlayerController] for a player's backpack - it then outlives the pawn - under a pawn root, or on a chest in the level. The server's list is the truth. A client gets a read-only mirror ([member replication_mode]): on [code]_ready[/code] it asks for the whole list, after that every change reaches it once per frame, and the same signals fire on both sides. Changing a mirror is refused with an error. [codeblock] # Server: a stack of five, topping up existing stacks first. inventory.add_items(preload("res://items/arrow.tres"), 5) [/codeblock]

method.name: add_item_definition
method.description: Server: one new entry of [param count] units (capped at the definition's max stack size), or [code]null[/code] when the inventory is full. Never merges into an existing stack: two entries of one definition are two instances, each with its own state.

method.name: add_item_instance
method.description: Server: takes in an instance that already exists - its stats and data come with it. An instance in another inventory is removed from there first. An instance already here gets [param count] more units.

method.name: add_items
method.description: Server: [param count] units, topping up existing stacks before starting new ones. Returns how many fitted.

method.name: can_add_item_definition
method.description: Whether [param count] units fit, topping up existing stacks first.

method.name: clear
method.description: Server: removes every entry.

method.name: client_receive_full_state
method.description: RPC: the whole list, sent to a client that asked.

method.name: client_update
method.description: RPC: the entries that changed and the ids that left, once per frame.

method.name: consume_items
method.description: Server: takes [param count] units of the definition, newest stacks first. All or nothing: with fewer units than that it takes none and returns [code]false[/code].

method.name: find_first_item_stack_by_definition
method.description: The first entry of the definition, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: find_item_anywhere
method.description: The instance with this id in any inventory in [param from]'s tree, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: find_item_by_id
method.description: The instance with this [method InventoryItemInstance.get_item_id], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_all_items
method.description: Every instance, in list order.

method.name: get_entry_count
method.description: How many entries there are.

method.name: get_stack_count
method.description: The entry's unit count, or [code]0[/code] when the instance is not here.

method.name: get_total_item_count_by_definition
method.description: Units of the definition across all its entries - two stacks of five are ten.

method.name: has_authority
method.description: True where the list may be changed: offline, and on the server.

method.name: is_mirror
method.description: True on a networked client holding a mirror of the server's list.

method.name: remove_item_instance
method.description: Server: removes the entry. Returns [code]false[/code] when the instance is not here.

method.name: server_request_full_state
method.description: RPC: a client asks for the whole list.

method.name: set_stack_count
method.description: Server: sets an entry's unit count; [code]0[/code] removes the entry.

members.member: How many entries fit; [code]0[/code] is unlimited.
Who gets a mirror of the list. [constant REPLICATION_OWNER] suits a backpack; [constant REPLICATION_EVERYONE] a chest anybody may look into.

signal.name: changed
signal.description: Anything changed: entries, counts, an instance's stats or data.

signal.name: item_added
signal.description: A new entry appeared with [param count] units.

signal.name: replicated_state_received
signal.description: A client's mirror got the whole list for the first time (or again).

signal.name: stack_changed
signal.description: An entry's unit count changed; [param new_count] is [code]0[/code] when it left.

constants.constant: Every peer keeps its own list, as offline.
Only the peer owning the parent gets a mirror.
